mapper.select:
SELECT srrd.id, srrd.main_id, srr.source_id, srrd.source_detail_id, srr.source_code, srr.code, srrd.sku_id, srrd.sku_no, srrd.receive_qty, srrd.remark, srr.approve_status FROM so_return_receive_detail srrd INNER JOIN so_return_receive srr ON srrd.main_id = srr.id AND srrd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE srr.is_deleted = FALSE
and srr.id in
#{id}
ORDER BY srrd.main_id

SELECT srrd.main_id AS sourceId, srr.code AS sourceCode, srrd.id AS sourceDetailId, srrd.sku_id, srrd.sku_no, srrd.receive_qty AS totalQty, srr.source_id AS soReturnId, srrd.source_detail_id AS soReturnDetailId, srr.source_code AS soReturnCode, srr.so_code, srr.so_id, srr.warehouse_id FROM so_return_receive_detail srrd LEFT JOIN so_return_receive srr ON srrd.main_id = srr.id AND srr.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE srrd.is_deleted = FALSE AND srrd.main_id IN
#{item}

SELECT DISTINCT srr.id, srr.code, srr.so_code, srr.seller_name, srr.warehouse_id, srr.warehouse_name, srr.approve_status, srr.create_time FROM so_return_receive srr LEFT JOIN so_return_receive_detail srrd ON srr.id = srrd.main_id AND srrd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE srr.is_deleted = FALSE AND srr.invalid_status = FALSE AND srr.approve_status = 'approve'
AND srrd.sku_no = #{skuNo}
AND srr.code ILIKE concat('%', #{code}::text ,'%')
ORDER BY srr.create_time
